questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Invention] How does a non-contact thermometer measure temperature?
A. By projecting a beam of light onto an object and measuring how it refracts
B. By measuring the radiation naturally emitted by an object
C. By using a laser
Answer: B. Most commercial non-contact thermometer only passively captures the infrared radiation emitted by an object using a lens to focus the radiation onto a detector.
questions.de: Was bündelt ein berührungsloses (Infrarot-)Thermometer auf seinen Detektor, um daraus die Temperatur eines Gegenstands abzuleiten?
questions.en: What does a non-contact (infrared) thermometer focus onto its detector to infer an object's temperature?
questions.answerEn: The infrared radiation the object emits

timeline.labelEn: William Herschel discovers infrared radiation through its effect on a thermometer
timeline.labelDe: William Herschel entdeckt die Infrarotstrahlung durch ihre Wirkung auf ein Thermometer

questions.notes: Wikipedia: a lens focuses the infrared thermal radiation onto a detector. Laser dots on such devices only aid aiming. Card grammar slip: 'Most commercial non-contact thermometer'. Timeline from the Infrared article.

questions.cardText:
[Literature] Which famous fictional character lived at 221B Baker Street?
A. Hercule Poirot
B. Sherlock Holmes
C. Miss Marple
Answer: B.
questions.de: Welcher berühmte fiktive Detektiv wohnte in der Londoner Baker Street 221B?
questions.en: Which famous fictional detective lived at 221B Baker Street in London?

timeline.labelEn: Arthur Conan Doyle's novel A Study in Scarlet introduces Sherlock Holmes's lodgings at 221B Baker Street
timeline.labelDe: Arthur Conan Doyles Roman „Eine Studie in Scharlachrot“ führt Sherlock Holmes' Wohnung in der Baker Street 221B ein

questions.notes: Open once the options are dropped; Holmes shared the rooms with Dr Watson.
